title: Hamster eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- hamster body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='30' ry='24' fill='#d9a066'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#f4e0be'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='24' fill='#e0ad72'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='50' r='11' fill='#f4e0be'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='50' r='11' fill='#f4e0be'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='22' r='8' fill='#c98f52'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='22' r='8' fill='#c98f52'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='22' r='4' fill='#f0b8b0'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='22' r='4' fill='#f0b8b0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='40' r='4.5' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='40' r='4.5' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='38.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='38.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='3.5' ry='2.6' fill='#e3877f'/>
  <!-- snack: sunflower seed held in paws -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#4a3a5c' transform='rotate(-20 50 58)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='2.4' ry='4' fill='#8a7aa0' transform='rotate(-20 50 58)'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='60' r='4.5' fill='#f4e0be'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='60' r='4.5' fill='#f4e0be'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='90' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f4e0be'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='90' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f4e0be'/>
</svg>
